module.purpose: Selects and orders round-robin users for an event by combining availability, booking history, priorities, weights, calendar occupancy, routing-form attributes, virtual queues, and out-of-office intervals.
module.summary: This module implements Cal.com round-robin assignment. It fetches calendar, booking, host, routing-form, attribute, and out-of-office data, derives reset intervals, calibrates hosts added during an interval, applies attribute weights and priorities, and selects the least recently booked eligible user. It also exposes an ordering operation that repeatedly removes selected users to produce a complete deterministic ordering.
module.businessContext: Supports fair and configurable meeting assignment among event hosts and teams. Failures can misroute bookings, violate weighted distribution, or prevent scheduling.
